content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0–3 reps left) build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5–30 reps. Lighter weights just need more reps per set and are tougher on your lungs and patience.

Heavy work still earns its place for you. Your goal is a 100 kg bench, and strength is specific, so you need to practice heavy, low-rep sets (around 3–6 reps) on the bench. A good mix is heavy compound lifts for strength, plus moderate sets of 8–15 reps on accessories for size. 💪
